title: April memory exploration
notes: Memory Q&A paused for this research. Supermemory is a reference, not a selected provider.
questions: Provider choice, inference review policy, historical revival, deletion propagation, private context enforcement.

decisions.title: Sources
decisions.caption: Original evidence
decisions.rationale: Store source material separately from extracted facts and prompt context. Index completion and memory extraction completion are distinct.

decisions.title: Extraction
decisions.caption: Background learning
decisions.rationale: Dynamic dreaming groups related material. Instant processing handles one document when immediate availability matters; this is not a guarantee of zero latency.

decisions.title: Relationships
decisions.caption: Update · extend · derive
decisions.rationale: A changed fact replaces current truth; added detail enriches it; an inference is a conclusion not explicitly stated. Preserve the distinction between evidence and guesses.

decisions.title: Recall
decisions.caption: Chunks · graph · profile
decisions.rationale: Use chunks to ground answers, graph facts for connected knowledge, and static/dynamic profiles for compact context. April must filter all three by current task authority.

decisions.title: Time expiry
decisions.caption: Temporary relevance ends
decisions.rationale: Supermemory describes automatic expiry of temporary facts. Legacy APIs expose scheduled forgetting; do not copy those fields into v5 without compatibility validation. Expiry is not proof of physical erasure.

decisions.title: Superseded facts
decisions.caption: Current truth changes
decisions.rationale: Updated information takes precedence for current answers; older facts can remain historical. Ambiguous contradictions in April’s wiki still require user clarification.

decisions.title: Soft forgetting
decisions.caption: Hidden from normal recall
decisions.rationale: The current memory operation excludes a forgotten fact from normal search but preserves it. Forgetting is separate from source deletion and permanent erasure.

decisions.title: Historical recall
decisions.caption: Retrievable is not revived
decisions.rationale: Migration docs distinguish list visibility from search including forgotten records. Historical retrieval does not itself mean a fact should become current again. April’s revival policy remains open.

decisions.title: Inference review
decisions.caption: Approve · decline · undo
decisions.rationale: Inferred memories can be approved, declined or returned to an unreviewed state. Decline forgets an inference; undo can un-forget that declined item. Do not generalize this to every deletion.

decisions.title: Permanent deletion
decisions.caption: Separate lifecycle
decisions.rationale: April’s recoverable bin and weekly user review remain authoritative. Validate cleanup of sources, chunks, summaries, facts, profiles, caches and backups; soft forgetting alone is insufficient.

decisions.title: Private context
decisions.caption: Task grant before processing
decisions.rationale: Keep financial and medical material out of general memory. Only task-approved content can enter agent processing; derived content stays private and user viewing remains independent.

decisions.title: Correction APIs
decisions.caption: Version-specific behavior
decisions.rationale: Older docs expose direct memory updates; current v5 docs update source documents and reprocess their memories. Pin and test an API version instead of combining examples.

decisions.title: Deployment
decisions.caption: Provider remains open
decisions.rationale: Decided: build April’s own memory subsystem. Supermemory remains a strong reference, not a hosted or self-hosted dependency.

decisions.title: Privacy audit
decisions.caption: No training ≠ zero retention
decisions.rationale: Audit exact processors, extraction paths, retention, logs and contracts. Self-hosting with remote models can still send data elsewhere.

decisions.title: Correction test
decisions.caption: Synthetic fixtures first
decisions.rationale: Correct a preference and verify current answers, history and profile refresh. Distinguish time-based changes from ambiguous contradictions.

decisions.title: Expiry and recall test
decisions.caption: No silent revival
decisions.rationale: Expire and forget facts, inspect default recall and authorized history, and test rejected-inference regeneration. Establish April’s explicit revival rules before implementation.

decisions.title: Privacy and purge test
decisions.caption: No general-profile leakage
decisions.rationale: Grant one private source to one task; verify sibling data stays inaccessible, expiry blocks later agent use, and deletion propagates through derived stores.

decisions.title: Cost and quality
decisions.caption: Measure April’s workload
decisions.rationale: Benchmark English/Hindi, readiness delays, replay, retrieval errors and ingestion costs with synthetic data. No provider benchmark claims are treated as proof.

decisions.title: Owned memory; credited references
decisions.rationale: April will build its own memory system. Supermemory is a strong reference, not a dependency. Credit material design influences in the root README.
decisions.caption: Confirmed April decision

decisions.title: Tentative inferences
decisions.rationale: Use low-risk inferences tentatively and ask before consequential reliance. Keep inference distinct from confirmed fact.
decisions.caption: Confirmed April decision

decisions.title: Temporary memory expiry
decisions.rationale: Temporary facts expire from current recall while remaining history. Explicit corrections take precedence immediately; clarify ambiguous conflicts.
decisions.caption: Confirmed April decision

decisions.title: Intentional forgetting
decisions.rationale: Exclude forgotten facts from normal recall and prevent relearning from unchanged sources. Consult them only on specific user request; ask before restoring normal memory. Permanent erasure is separate.
decisions.caption: Confirmed April decision

decisions.title: Shared data standards and profiles
decisions.rationale: Use Supermemory’s automatic durable/recent profile behavior as reference, without a separate pinning requirement. Memory shares product-wide encryption and data-management standards.
decisions.caption: Confirmed April decision

decisions.title: Background memory readiness
decisions.rationale: A short extraction delay is acceptable for grouped background learning. Explicit corrections apply immediately in the active conversation; persistent propagation needs design.
decisions.caption: Confirmed April decision

decisions.title: Memory inspection provenance
decisions.rationale: Show each fact’s source and distinguish stated facts from inferred conclusions.
decisions.caption: Confirmed April decision

decisions.title: Task outcome learning
decisions.rationale: Remember useful successes and failures. Agent claims remain unverified until evidence supports them; private restrictions still govern reuse.
decisions.caption: Confirmed April decision

decisions.title: User notes versus agent claims
decisions.rationale: User notes take precedence over conflicting agent claims; nudge the user about discrepancies. Other ambiguous conflicts require clarification.
decisions.caption: Confirmed April decision

decisions.title: No-durable-memory mode
decisions.rationale: Provide a don’t-remember-this mode excluding the conversation from durable memory. Transcript retention and mode scope remain open.
decisions.caption: Confirmed April decision

decisions.title: No-memory transcript and lifetime
decisions.rationale: Omit saved transcripts and durable extraction. Persist until explicitly turned off with a visible indicator, including across dismissal/resummoning.
decisions.caption: Confirmed April decision

decisions.title: Cross-device no-memory and artifacts
decisions.rationale: Apply across devices. Confirm retention of specifically requested saved artifacts. Excluded conversations remain excluded permanently after mode exit; no retroactive learning.
decisions.caption: Confirmed April decision

decisions.title: Memory design paused
decisions.rationale: The user deferred remaining memory detail. Correction propagation, running-task handling and internal grouping are unanswered. Resume later on request; owned memory and all confirmed decisions remain in force.
decisions.caption: Confirmed April decision
